launches.title: RightNow: own your AI, at full speed
launches.tagline: Open model inference on the kernel stack frontier labs use
launches.body:
![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=129243&key=user_uploads/1615104/7fdb4138-f2b2-48fd-9e2c-dff45ed6a8ee)

**TL;DR:** We are a GPU kernel lab. Top frontier labs use our optimization tools to get more out of their GPUs. Now we are opening the same stack to everyone, so you can own your AI and run it at full speed.

Most providers rent GPUs and run the same stock serving stack, so they all land at the same speed and the same price. We write the GPU kernels ourselves. Every model we serve is optimized down to the hardware, so each GPU does more work.

## What you can do with it

* Call the best open models at full speed with one key, as a drop-in for the OpenAI and Anthropic client libraries
* Reserve capacity that is held for your traffic
* Get a dedicated deployment that serves only your company
* Run batch jobs at half price
* Bring us your own model and we will optimize it down to the kernel

Prices start at $0.05 per 1M input tokens. Prompt caching is automatic, and the live cache hit rate for every model is on our pricing page.

## Why we built it

You should not have to rent your intelligence from a closed lab at whatever speed and price they choose. Open models are good enough now. We make them fast enough.

People are already doing this. Revolut moved 2,000 engineers from Claude Code and Codex to GLM 5.3 on dedicated GPUs and cut its AI coding bill by about 90%.

It took them an infrastructure team and months of tuning. With RightNow you get the same model at full speed on day one.

## Work with us

If you spend more than $1k a month on inference, send us your heaviest workload. We will move it over in a day and show you the speed and the bill side by side.

If you train your own model, talk to us. We will optimize it down to the kernel and serve it for you.

If you know a team that is slow or overpaying on open models, an intro is the best thing you can do for us.

* Get started now for free: <https://www.rightnowai.co>
* Startups get up to $2,600 in credits: <https://www.rightnowai.co/startups>
* Book time with us: <https://yc.link/cal/TJkX4M1u7P>
